AES Fleet Limited.note: AES Fleet (trading as Auto Electrical Services) operates as an independent UK provider of web and telematics-based fleet management solutions.

Allstar Business Solutions Limited.note: FleetCor Technologies acquired Allstar Business Solutions Limited from The Arval Group in 2011.

Automatrics Limited.note: Automatrics Limited remains a privately owned and steadily growing independent tracking security business.

Bulk Tainer Telematics Limited.note: Bulk Tainer Telematics Limited was acquired by Intermodal Tank Transport as part of its acquisition of Bulk Tainer Group on August 29, 2025.

Cloud Cycle Ltd.note: The company is active and independent, having secured a strategic investment and global commercial partnership from Holcim in September 2026 rather than being acquired.

Corvia Limited.note: Tenzing Private Equity made a substantial investment to acquire a majority stake in Corvia Limited in 2018.

Dynamon Limited.note: Dynamon Limited remains independent and active, with its founder Angus Webb retaining majority control following a £4 million Series A investment round from BP Ventures in 2023.

Fargo Systems Ltd.note: August Equity acquired a majority stake in Fargo Systems Ltd alongside its management team in 2024.

Fleetclear.note: Innovative Safety Systems Ltd (ISS) rebranded to Fleetclear in 2022 after receiving a significant investment from YFM Equity Partners.

Ford Fleet Management UK Limited.note: Ford Fleet Management UK Limited was established in 2020 as a joint venture between Ford and Ayvens (formerly ALD Automotive) and remains an active operating company.

Lightbulb Analytics Ltd.note: Lightbulb Analytics Ltd was acquired by Volaris Group subsidiary AssetWorks LLC in August 2021.

Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd.note: Mobil Information Systems was acquired by Total Specific Solutions (TSS) in April 2023.

Track Metrics Ltd.note: Track Metrics Ltd remains an active, independent technology company focused on bespoke software and telematics solutions.

Transpoco Limited.note: Transpoco Limited operates independently and expanded its own group by incorporating the fleet safety firm Safely.

VNC Automotive Limited.note: The business spun off from RealVNC and launched as an independent company following a private management buyout in 2018.

Visual Telematics Ltd.note: Visual Telematics Ltd functions as an active, independent family-run vehicle security and telematics provider.

iTracking Limited.note: iTracking Limited operates as an independent sales partner providing localized fleet telematics solutions.
